# Intralog

> Intralog is a warehouse automation integrator (design-build) headquartered in
> Salt Lake City, Utah. We design and integrate material handling systems —
> pallet shuttles, vertical lift modules (VLMs), conveyor and sortation, AMRs/AGVs,
> and robotic palletizing — for 3PLs and mid-market distribution centers
> (300k–500k sq ft). Phone: (385) 500-4667 · Email: info@intralog.io

## Solutions by technology

- [Pallet Shuttle Systems](https://intralog.io/solutions/by-technology/pallet-shuttle-systems): Semi-automated deep-lane storage, FIFO/LIFO, cold-storage rated
- [Goods-to-Person / VLMs](https://intralog.io/solutions/by-technology/goods-to-person-vlms): Modula Lift and FlexiBox vertical storage with pick-to-light
- [Conveyor & Sortation](https://intralog.io/solutions/by-technology/conveyor-and-sortation): Belt, MDR, live roller, and high-speed sortation (Daifuku Wynright)
- [Palletizing & Depalletizing](https://intralog.io/solutions/by-technology/palletizing-and-de-palletizing): Robotic cells, vision-guided depal, SSCC labeling
- [Conventional Storage](https://intralog.io/solutions/by-technology/conventional-storage-systems): Selective rack, pushback, pallet flow, carton flow, pick modules
- [Print & Apply](https://intralog.io/solutions/by-technology/print-and-apply): Inline labeling with verification

## Software

- [Warehousr](https://intralog.io/software/warehousr): Open-source warehouse analytics and diagnostics toolkit
- [DensityPro](https://intralog.io/software/densitypro): Orchestration for multi-shuttle deep-lane operations
- [Painless Permit](https://intralog.io/software/painlesspermit): Permit package automation for rack and automation projects
